pieceDesc.OU: Moves one square in any of the eight directions. Losing this piece ends the game.
pieceDesc.KY: Slides forward any number of squares. Blocked by any piece in its path.
pieceDesc.KE: Jumps two squares forward and one to either side, hopping over any piece in between.
pieceDesc.GI: Moves one square in its three forward directions, or diagonally backward.
pieceDesc.KI: Moves one square in its three forward directions, sideways, or straight back.
pieceDesc.KA: Slides diagonally any number of squares. Blocked by any piece in its path.
pieceDesc.HI: Slides horizontally or vertically any number of squares. Blocked by any piece in its path.
pieceDesc.FU: Moves one square straight forward only.

game.resignConfirmBody: Resigning records this game as a loss.

errors.kingInCheck: That move would leave your own king in check.

learn.step1Body: Shogi is a traditional Japanese board game played on a 9×9, 81-square board. You (Sente) sit at the bottom; your opponent (Gote) sits at the top.
learn.step2Body: Shogi has 8 kinds of pieces, each moving differently. Tap a piece below to see how it moves.
learn.step3Body: Click a piece to see its legal destinations highlighted in green, and any capturable enemy piece outlined in red.
learn.step4Body: Entering or moving within the far three ranks lets you flip a piece over into a stronger, promoted form.
learn.step5Body: Shogi's signature rule: a captured piece doesn't vanish — it joins your hand, and you may drop it back onto any empty square as your own.
learn.step6Body: Now let's play a few real moves to make the rules click.
learn.tutorialIntro: Let's begin! Protect your king while driving your opponent's king into checkmate.
